title: Accounting and Tax Services for Heavy Equipment Operators

rows.before: We incorporated the company under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved the excavators, haul trucks and goodwill across on a section 85 rollover with no gain triggered, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 12.2%, filed the outstanding T5018s, and fixed the RC4110 worker classification.
rows.after: We incorporated the company under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved the excavators, haul trucks and goodwill across on a section 85 rollover with no gain triggered, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026), filed the outstanding T5018s, and fixed the RC4110 worker classification.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

rows.before: Active income taxed near the 12.2% small-business rate
rows.after: Active income taxed near the 11.2% small-business rate
